data_request_notes_length.name: data_request_notes_length
data_request_notes_length.value: "data_requests"."notes" is null or char_length("data_requests"."notes") between 10 and 500

data_request_closure.name: data_request_closure
data_request_closure.value: "data_requests"."status" not in ('completed','rejected') or ("data_requests"."notes" is not null and "data_requests"."completed_at" is not null)

data_request_subject.name: data_request_subject
data_request_subject.value: "data_requests"."user_id" is null or "data_requests"."subject_verified_at" is not null

report_closure_note.name: report_closure_note
report_closure_note.value: "content_reports"."status" not in ('actioned','dismissed') or ("content_reports"."resolution_note" is not null and "content_reports"."handled_at" is not null)
